levels.label: 2. OG — left-side correction study
levels.source: Resident-confirmed twenty-room count, left-side correction image and stairwell-entrance clarification supplied on 15 November 2026, aligned to Bavaria’s unchanged exterior model.
levels.notes: Twenty rooms and their general groups remain resident-confirmed. L1–L3 now shift between the marked source corners as three approximately 2.94m gross bays, retaining the previous roughly 5.40m model depth. The narrower stairwell is provisionally half a neighboring bay wide; its schematic flight leaves landing areas clear. The green-marked west-hall entrance into the stairwell is confirmed in location, with an illustrative 1.10m opening. The east hall's stairwell connection is unknown and is not invented. The other seventeen room polygons stay unchanged, including unresolved R1–R3 at about 2.69m gross width. Full apartment dimensions, service layouts, wall thickness, openings and floor height remain unmeasured. Study labels are not room numbers. Both lower floors retain the earlier frozen sketch.
